description.value:
Mist-Servant Technique — the False Surroundings Trick. You overlay an illusion of altered surroundings on a single target you can see within 60 feet: a wall where there is none, a hidden door that isn't real, or a person standing in the wrong place.

The target attempts a Will save. On a failure, they perceive your illusion as real and act accordingly for up to 1 minute (you must Sustain). They get a new save when they interact with the illusion in a way that would expose it (touching, attacking through it, etc.).

This jutsu only convinces a single mind; observers around the target see things as they really are.

Heightened (4th) You may target up to 3 creatures with a single casting.
